title: Western Star 4800 Heavy Duty FUPS Aluminium Bullbar #15
description: Western Star 4800 heavy duty Extra Deep Texas style FUPS Bullbar. Built with 80mm diameter pipe and 100mm wide heavy duty box uprights. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Custom driving light mounts to customer specifications. Optional Dimension & Road Train signs on main bar. LED indicator repeater/daylight running lights in outer uprights.
